lines.text: Jesus stood by the Lake of Gennesaret, saw two boats, and taught the crowd from Simon's boat.
Jesus told Simon to put out into deep water, and Simon said they had caught nothing all night.
Their nets began to tear, so they signaled their servants in the other boat, and both boats began to sink.
Simon Peter fell at Jesus' knees, and James and John, the sons of Alphaeus, were astonished at the catch.
They brought their boats ashore, left everything, and followed Jesus.
